title: Bye Bye Perspective API: Lessons for Measurement Infrastructure in NLP, CSS and LLM Evaluation
summary: 本文讨论了Perspective API的退役对NLP、CSS和LLM评估中测量基础设施的影响，并从中提炼出关于构建可持续测量系统的经验教训。
highlights: Perspective API的关闭凸显了依赖外部测量工具的脆弱性。
文章为NLP和LLM评估中的测量基础设施提供了改进建议。
讨论了CSS（计算社会科学）中测量工具的可持续性问题。

title: Researchers use AI to ‘democratize’ 3D printing of crucial metal alloy
summary: Researchers at Washington State University have developed an AI-based method to optimize 3D printing parameters for a critical metal alloy, making the process more accessible and cost-effective. The approach reduces the need for expensive trial-and-error experiments, potentially democratizing advanced manufacturing.
highlights: AI optimizes 3D printing of crucial metal alloy
Democratizes access to advanced manufacturing
Reduces trial-and-error costs

title: BenchMIRT: What are LLM benchmarks actually measuring?
summary: 本文探讨了LLM基准测试的实际测量内容，指出传统基准可能高估模型能力，并提出BenchMIRT框架以更准确评估模型推理与理解。
highlights: Benchmarks often conflate memorization with reasoning, leading to inflated performance scores.
The proposed BenchMIRT framework separates core reasoning from auxiliary skills to provide clearer insights.
Current evaluation methods may not reflect real-world generalization, necessitating more targeted tests.

highlights: 200+ WebGPU kernels for local AI inference

Supports various model architectures and operators
Easy-to-use API for developers
